name: Zscaler — DLP Block on Upload to Cloud Storage (Insider Exfil)
xql_query:
dataset = zscaler_nssweblog_raw
| filter act = "Blocked"
| filter reason = "DLP Block"
| filter src != null and suser != null
| alter src_ip = src, user_name = suser, url = request, dlp_rule = cs3, dst_ip = dst
description: Zscaler NSS web log Blocked action with reason=DLP Block — insider uploading sensitive data (Source Code / PII) to external cloud storage (Online Storage category, e.g. mega.nz). Correlated to the insider by src and suser.
alert_name: Zscaler — DLP Block on Upload to Cloud Storage (Insider Exfil)
